summary: Implemented the speed feature in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default off) and a static render_speed method, which renders None as empty text and otherwise scales the speed via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix to "X.Y<suffix> it/s". render shows speed when the total is None and show_speed is on. Module-level track() gained show_speed=True and passes it to the column. Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables; the total stays None. Added a CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added entry. In tests/test_progress.py, removed the two ValueError assertions and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Tests were not run, per instructions, and nothing was committed.
